task: Bounded Amiga ADF/ADZ source pathname replacement correction
defect: Reading the pinned descriptor did not prove that the original pathname still named that inspected object when evidence was returned. ADZ also omitted a final descriptor check after decoding and logical inspection.
correction: Capture opened-descriptor device/inode/size/mtime using the existing CapturedFileIdentity primitive plus ctime. Check the descriptor and resolve the original pathname with metadata before returning the inspection result. Never read or reopen the replacement pathname. Changed sources override content failures with ChangedWhileReading; metadata I/O stays InspectionUnavailable.

compatibility_limit: The stack and scoped correction are disjoint from later main changes and merge-tree is conflict-free. The combined tree was not integrated or compiled. Exact committed correction merge-tree verification is recorded separately after commit.
residual_filesystem_limitations: The final pathname check is a point-in-time check. Another process can replace the pathname immediately afterward; this is not permanent source locking or an atomic filesystem snapshot.

Metadata identity checks cannot guarantee detection of every in-place edit when size/timestamps are restored or indistinguishable at filesystem timestamp granularity. Device/inode checks still detect replacement while the inspected descriptor remains open.
evidence_contract: Strong means the existing bounded OFS/FFS boot/root metadata checks passed. It establishes no full filesystem or dump integrity, game identity, launch readiness or trainer availability.
independent_review: Required by a different agent on the exact final local commit. No push, merge or promotion performed.
